headline: Evaluating proposals to make Our Lady of Victories and Michael priorities for major conservation, with public comment.
summary: Public comment will be taken on the conservation proposals. Other items include the Gabriel Frey artist commission at First Light Commons and a discussion of community artwork guidelines.
items: City Clerk opens application for vacant seat on the committee
Encumbrances for new acquisitions: Bramhall Square Redesign and Congress Square Park – Phase 2
Heidi Dikeman to be appointed as Creative Portland representative on December 1, 2026
Gabriel Frey artist commission at First Light Commons: subcommittee chair project updates
Discussion of public art guidelines section VI, guidelines for community artworks
Conservation priority projects: evaluate proposals for Our Lady of Victories and Michael as priorities for major conservation (public comment taken)
location: City Hall – Room 209, 389 Congress Street, Portland, ME 04101
plain_text:
PORTLAND PUBLIC ART COMMITTEE 
Wednesday, November 18, 2026 
4:00 PM City Hall – Room 209, 389 Congress Street, Portland, ME 04101 
 
1. Zoom Meeting Information  
  
 
Join from PC, Mac, iPad, or Android: 
https://portlandmaine-gov.zoom.us/j/81634418875 
 
Phone one-tap: 
+1(929)205-6099 (Raise hand *9, Unmute *6) 
 
Webinar ID: 816 3441 8875 
      
2. Call to Order  
3. Approval of the October 21, 2026 Meeting Minutes  
  
 
October 21, 2026 Meeting Minutes 
      
4. Staff Communication - No public comment will be taken  
  
 
A. City Clerk opens application for vacant seat on the Public Art Committee 
      
  
 
B. Public art fund 
      
  
 
C. Encumbrances for new acquisitions of public art 
a. Bramhall Square Redesign 
b. Congress Square Park – Phase 2 
      
5. Governance Subcommittee - No public comment will be taken  
  
 
A. Creative Portland Appointee 
Announcement item: Heidi Dikeman will be appointed as the Creative Portland representative 
to the Portland Public Art Committee on December 1, 2026. 
      
6. Acquisitions Subcommittee - No public comment will be taken  
  
 
A. Gabriel Frey artist commission at First Light Commons 
Announcement item: Subcommittee chair to provide project updates. 
      
  
 
B. Public art guidelines 
Discussion item: Introduce a Committee discussion to evaluate the public art guidelines section 
VI. Guidelines for community artworks. 
      
7. Collection Management Subcommittee  
  
 
A. Conservation priority projects - Public comment will be taken 
Voting item: The Committee to evaluate the proposals received for Our Lady of Victories and 
Michael as priorities for major conservation. 
      
8. Communication Subcommittee - No public comment will be taken
9. New Committee Business - No public comment  
10. Adjourn  
 
Next Meeting - December 16, 2026
